name: Magpie AI Agent Router
author: OmniDesk
description: Reads local magpie harnesses/models/quotas, routes requests through group/omnidesk-active, and drives chat, translation, companion agent, and AI curation.

config_schema.label: 翻译接口 / 端口（可选）
config_schema.description: 本地 OpenAI 兼容网关地址；留空沿用 Magpie 网关

config_schema.label: 独立翻译模型
config_schema.description: 模型 ID，多个用英文逗号分隔并按批次轮流使用；留空沿用当前路由

config_schema.label: Magpie CLI 路径
config_schema.description: Executable name on PATH or absolute path to magpie

config_schema.label: Magpie 网关地址（仅限回环）
config_schema.description: Loopback-only base URL for Magpie OpenAI-compatible gateway (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:3425)

config_schema.label: OmniDesk 专属路由组
config_schema.description: Dedicated Magpie group ID managed by OmniDesk (group/omnidesk-active)

config_schema.label: 路由调度策略
config_schema.description: Magpie group routing policy for group/omnidesk-active

config_schema.label: 会话粘性策略
config_schema.description: Magpie group stays policy for group/omnidesk-active

config_schema.label: 推理超时（毫秒）
config_schema.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for Magpie /v1/chat/completions calls

config_schema.label: Magpie Gateway Key（可选）
config_schema.description: Stored exclusively in 0600 SecretVault (never written to plain config or logs)

config_schema.label: Codex CLI 路径
config_schema.description: 留空自动检测 PATH 与 ~/.local/npm/bin/codex

config_schema.label: Codex 模型
config_schema.description: 留空使用 Codex CLI 自身默认模型；独立于 Magpie 路由

config_schema.label: Codex 独立翻译模型（逗号分隔）
AGY 独立翻译模型（逗号分隔）
AGY CLI 路径（留空自动检测）
AGY Agent 模型（留空使用 CLI 默认）
